questions.question: Where did the exiles sit and weep in Psalm 137?
options: On the heights of Mount Zion
In the courts of the temple
Along the banks of the Jordan

questions.question: What did their captors ask them to do?
options: Sing them one of the songs of Zion
Tell them the secrets of the temple
Bring them the treasures of Jerusalem
Bow down before the gods of Babylon
questions.answer: Sing them one of the songs of Zion

questions.question: The exiles hung up their lyres on the willows and asked how they could sing the LORD's song in a foreign land.
By the waters of _____, there we sat down and wept, when we remembered Zion.
If I forget you, O _____, let my right hand forget its skill!
